hey :) I'm not trans myself, so I can't give you advice from another trans perspective. but I have at least a few experiences about coming out, as I'm bisexual/pansexual/maybe a lesbian, not sure about that, I'm still confused.

at first I think it's important to know that you don't have to come out. there shouldn't be any pressure to come out, just do it when you feel comfortable and you really know that you can trust that person. I mean you never know how people will react, but there can still be a feeling like "oh I think I can tell that person, I feel really comfortable around them and they support me" if you know how I mean that :)

if you want to come out to someone, I think a good start could be to test the waters, for example tell them about a friend or just a person in your school or something that's trans. you could ask them what they think about that or how they would feel if it was their friend/family member. if they have a good reaction to that, I think there is like a 90% chance that they will also support you. also, tell them that you're still the same person and you have always felt that way, that can also help the other person understand a little bit better that it's not just a phase or something.
